ai.title: AI could free up 40% of middle, back-office capacity in banking sector by 2030: Report
ai.description: Artificial intelligence could free up to 40% of the banking workforce in middle- and back-office roles by 2030, reshaping operations and boosting efficiency in corporate and investment banking, says BCG.

ai.description_cn: 根据BCG的研究，到2030年，人工智能可以释放高达40%的银行业员工，这些员工原本从事的是中基层管理工作。这将有助于重塑银行业务运作方式，并提高企业和投资银行的运营效率。
